verdict.rationale: Mastra is code-first: agents, tools and workflows are built in TypeScript and can be registered on a Mastra server or shipped as standalone endpoints, while Studio is presented as an interface for building, testing and managing those same objects. Nothing in the evidence documents that every Studio action has a programmatic equivalent, and the probe found no published OpenAPI spec at the candidate paths. missing for 10: explicit API–UI parity documentation, a documented management API covering Studio's testing/managing/evaluation actions, a published OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Add a tool to an agent by importing the tool and passing it to the agent constructor as a tools object.
Register agents and workflows on one Mastra server, run it locally, and deploy the same app to Mastra Cloud.
Studio is the interface for building, testing, and managing agents, workflows, and tools.
